checklist.rule: Colors, spacing, radii and durations use only var(--g-*) tokens; no hex, rgb(), or hardcoded layout values.
The widget is readable in both light and dark themes; screenshots for both themes are provided.
All visible UI text comes from labels or params; no hardcoded user-facing strings are present.
Interactive controls use @grasp/primitives/ui (Button, Slider, Toggle, ModeTabs, StepControls) instead of local equivalents.
The widget fits a 320–800 px container without horizontal scrolling or clipped labels.
Text is at least var(--g-text-sm); elements and labels do not overlap.
Active or compared elements use --g-viz-active and a second non-color cue such as an outline or label.
Animations use var(--g-duration-*) and stop when reduced-motion durations are 0.
Every SVG root has role="img" and an aria-label; step captions are announced in an aria-live region.
The widget renders without console errors for every provided parameter set.
